## Eip5267Domain.extensions property

A list of EIP numbers, each of which MUST refer to an EIP that extends EIP-712 with new domain fields, along with a method to obtain the value for those fields, and potentially conditions for inclusion. The value of fields does not affect their inclusion.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly extensions: readonly bigint[];
```
